about.title: Make content from start to finish
about.body: New Media Contents brings video, design, web, 3D and XR together in one program. Students plan an idea, design it and build it into something that actually works, through classes and real projects.
about.planDesc: Decide what to make, who it is for and why, then shape the story and screens.
about.designDesc: Design how it looks and how it is used, through graphics, video, motion and UX.
about.devDesc: Make it work on the web, in apps, in interactive media and in XR.

department.policyPhotoAlt: Group photo of the global workshop in front of RMIT in Ho Chi Minh City
department.policyPhotoCaption: DIMA KR × RMIT VN Global Workshop · Ho Chi Minh City
policyItems: In step with the 4th Industrial Revolution and 5G, the department is equipped with the digital gear and computers needed to make VR/AR content and interactive content for smartphones and tablets.
Education is field-centered and practical, so what students learn can be used at work right away.
Students learn programming for VR/AR content (Java, Processing, etc.) and web development (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, JSP, etc.), combining theory and practice.
By building planning, design and programming skills together, we train convergence talent who adapt quickly to the professional field.

faqs.a: We accept applications through early admission (수시) and regular admission (정시). Please check the admissions office website for details.
A practical exam may be required depending on the admission type. Requirements may vary each year, so please check the official admissions office.
Yes, transfer admissions are also offered. Please refer to the admissions office notices for timing and eligibility requirements.
Some admission types may require a portfolio submission. Please check the specific year's admissions guide for detailed requirements.

sections.title: Personal Information Collected
sections.content:
This website may collect the following personal information during service use.

- Automatically collected: IP address, access time, browser information, cookies

sections.title: Purpose of Collection and Use
sections.content:
Collected information will not be used for purposes other than those listed below. Prior consent will be obtained if purposes change.

- Service provision and operation
- Service improvement and statistical analysis

sections.title: Retention and Use Period
sections.content: Personal information is destroyed immediately upon achievement of collection and use purposes. Information required under relevant laws will be retained for the prescribed period.

sections.title: Destruction Procedures and Methods
sections.content: Information in electronic file format is deleted using technical methods that prevent restoration of records.
